comment: Licences other than MIT or an equivalent need a recorded decision (02_constraints.md). Each entry names one package and the exact licence the lockfile reports for it. The licence check fails when a package is not allowed and not listed here, and when an entry no longer matches anything, so this file stays true.

exceptions.reason: Vite 8 depends on lightningcss to process CSS at build time. It is a development tool, its code is not part of the shipped app, and MPL-2.0 is a file-level licence that only asks for changes to its own files to be shared.
exceptions.decision: Proposed by the engineer and confirmed by Jeremy on 2026-11-13.

exceptions.reason: A table of SPDX licence-exception names, pulled in by eslint-plugin-jsdoc through spdx-expression-parse. It is data, not code, it is development-only, and it is not shipped.
exceptions.decision: Proposed by the engineer and confirmed by Jeremy on 2026-11-13.
